method: Match full-segment RMS to up to two seconds of original audio on each side, excluding the replaced interval. Constant gain on generated samples only; no fades or retiming. This is an audition, not a perceptual loudness or speech-quality gate.

cases.checks: Exact original prefix/suffix, exact gain-adjusted insert, unchanged sample count, finite PCM and matched RMS.
